data.introText: Our company is pleased to present this commercial proposal for the supply and deployment of the OSMOVIEW AI Video Analytics Platform based on computer vision technology for intelligent surveillance and automated incident detection on a software licensing basis.
data.projectDescription:
CONTEXT:
CONTEXT: The CASI project focuses on automating inventory management within a 200-square-meter warehouse facility. The primary challenge is to provide real-time tracking of pallet movements and current positions to eliminate manual scanning and human error.

FUNCTIONAL SCOPE: The system utilizes high-resolution cameras mounted overhead at 6.5 meters to detect fiducial markers (AprilTags) on pallets. It registers the entry of pallets into the system, tracks their movement between storage cells, and automatically logs shipment events when a pallet passes through the loading gates.

INFRASTRUCTURE: The solution involves 7 IP cameras (5MP) connected via PoE to a central server. The deployment includes software for real-time video processing and integration with warehouse management logic. The partner-integrator is responsible for structured cabling (SCS) and delivery of all required physical hardware.

FUNCTIONAL SCOPE:
Deployment of a computer vision system for tracking 5MP video streams, identifying AprilTags, and maintaining a digital twin of pallet locations in the warehouse.

INFRASTRUCTURE:
On-premise server with NVIDIA GPU for real-time marker detection and zone logic processing.
